summary: Validated the imported SHOP.M3D.pro app end-to-end. Backend: 23/23 pytest cases passed against the public preview URL (username+password login for all 4 seeded accounts root/@0root, admin/@0admin, lojista/@0lojista, cliente/@0cliente; /auth/me role verification; public endpoints /home, /stores, /whatsapp/status; admin flows /admin/metrics, /admin/users, /groups; vendor flow admin creates store -> lojista sees store_id in /auth/me -> creates product -> vendor/report returns daily/weekly/total/orders; customer flow /my/orders, /my/catalog-stores; RBAC 403 for cliente hitting admin). Frontend: mobile web preview loads /login, all 3 roles (root master, lojista, cliente) log in via testID selectors login-username/login-password/login-button and are redirected to their respective role dashboards (admin/vendor/customer tabs render correctly, no red screen, no page errors). No deprecated Expo packages detected (no expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch).

minor.issue: Returns empty list for non-master admin because it is scoped to lojistas of stores bound to that admin. Working as designed but seeded admin has no admin_store_ids so UI list will be empty until admin is bound to stores. Master (root) returns the full list correctly.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. And props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. These come from RN Web core; low priority, non-blocking. Reference: any screen using shadow.* from src/theme.

action_items: None blocking. Optionally: migrate shadow.* tokens in /app/frontend/src/theme to boxShadow to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
Optionally: document that /api/admin/users is scoped for non-master admins (or bind seeded admin to some stores) so the admin dashboard user list is non-empty.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3018 lines — beyond the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into routers (auth, stores, products, orders, admin, whatsapp, etc.) for maintainability.
MongoDB _id is properly excluded via projection {"_id": 0} in all queried admin/user/store endpoints inspected.
seed_data_creation: Test-scoped store (TEST_ShopM3D_Store_*) and product created via lojista fixture; teardown attempts DELETE of both.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Seeded accounts in /app/memory/test_credentials.md work. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_shopm3d_import.py as regression. Login endpoint is POST /api/auth/login with body {username, password}; returns {session_token, user}. /api/auth/me requires Bearer session_token. Frontend uses testIDs login-username, login-password, login-button on /login. Role routing: master/admin -> /(admin), lojista -> /(vendor), cliente -> /(customer).
